text:
If you’re heading onto Lake Champlain, a lake wind advisory is up: south winds 15 to 25 knots and waves up to 3 feet this afternoon. On shore, the day has stayed cloudy and cooler than the forecast so far, around 70 with a calm breeze, but the unsettled part is still ahead. Showers and a thunderstorm become possible after 4, and the models are much wetter than the official 30 percent chance, so I’d carry the rain jacket rather than bet on staying dry. Any early-evening shower should ease before 9, but another, more likely round is on the table between midnight and 5am.

Monday turns into the reset, mostly sunny with a high near 67, though northwest winds will keep the lake choppy. Enjoy the afternoon if you’re staying close to shore, but I’d finish open-water plans before 4 and keep tonight flexible.
